## Data

US macro data until 2007Q4

```{r data, fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5, message=FALSE}
library(bvartools)

# Specify URL
url <- "https://web.ics.purdue.edu/~jltobias/second_edition/Chapter17/code_for_exercise_1/realgdp.out"
# Load data
gdp <- read.delim(url, header = FALSE, skip = 1, sep = "", col.names = c("date", "gdp"))
# Format date
gdp <- ts(log(gdp[, "gdp"]), start = 1947, frequency = 4)
# Plot
plot(gdp, main = "")
```

## Exercise 17.1

Prepare the data

```{r}
library(bvartools)

temp <- gen_var(gdp, p = 3, deterministic = "const")
y <- temp$Y
x <- temp$Z

tt <- ncol(y)
m <- nrow(x)

q <- solve(tcrossprod(x))
beta <- tcrossprod(y, x) %*% q
v <- tt - m
s2 <- tcrossprod(y - beta %*% x) / v

vsq <- v / (v - 2) * as.numeric(s2) * q

iterations <- 10000

draws_beta <- matrix(NA, m, iterations)

for (draw in 1:iterations) {
  draws_beta[, draw] <- beta + mvtnorm::rmvt(1, sigma = vsq, df = v)
}

result <- coda::mcmc(t(draws_beta))
summary(result)
```
